column1: # Launch chains — the ONLY work that counts until launch.
# One row per chain. The scorecard reads the latest run of <workflow> in <repo>
# and reports PASS / FAIL / NOT_BUILT. A chain with no workflow is NOT_BUILT:
# an exit test that nothing can run is not an exit test.
# Every exit test must run WITHOUT staging or prod. The estate was torn down on
# 2026-08-16, so a test that needs a live cluster can never go green and is
# therefore not a valid exit test. Use kind, `terraform plan`, a rendered chart,
#   n  name  repo  workflow  root_issue  exit_test
